latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: file-steward 2.0.0 introduces automated semantic file organization based on the Six Dimensions of Life model.

- Implements semantic file classification using the 六维人生知识模型 instead of relying on file extensions.
- Files are organized strictly into a unified, unique two-level folder structure reflecting health, wealth, relationships, entertainment, knowledge, and wisdom.
- Adds robust handling of special cases: collected folders, unclassifiable files (moved to holding), and installation packages (dmg/exe).
- No file deletions are performed; only moving, renaming, and creating directories as needed.
- Directories are only created if they contain files; empty folders are moved to a holding area.
- Aims to build a personal knowledge OS and long-term evolvable file management system.
